note: Desensitized copy of the immutable snapshot the five arms were measured against. sha256 is of the published bytes; source_sha256 is of the studied bytes, so the identity of what was actually measured survives the transformation. This tree is evidence for anchor verification, not a runnable repository: the desensitization rewrites absolute paths that some of its own gates compare as identity strings.
